loci.rationale: Application form renders only email, amount, term, income band and the optional 'auto' route checkbox; no hobby or other purposeless input is offered to the applicant.
POST body is constrained to urlencoded form, size <=16000, max_num_fields=18, no duplicates, then flattened into data — the accepted payload boundary before submit().
Entrypoint: POST /apply passes the parsed data dict directly to store.submit, so the allowlist in submit governs what is accepted.
submit() enforces the decisive allowlist set(data) <= {email, amount, term, income, auto}, rejecting any unexpected field (e.g. hobby) with 'Unexpected application field.'
Validation of income band and route, then INSERT persists only owner, officer, email, amount, term, income, route, stage — no extra applicant attribute is stored.
cases schema columns (email, amount, term, income, confirmed, route, stage) contain no field lacking a business purpose in this fixture.
offer() sends onward only case id, email, amount and term — the necessary delivery/offer fields.
portable() exports only email, amount and income, bounding onward disclosure of applicant fields.
